title: Machine Learning and Blood-Targeted Proteomics Enable Early Prediction and Etiological Discrimination of Hypertensive Pregnancy Disorders.
summary: An 18-protein SVM based on first-trimester serum proteomics discriminated later preeclampsia from other groups and the FMF screen in this nested case-control study; the paper reports 94% sensitivity and 100% specificity in the study cohort. The model was tuned with repeated five-fold CV and evaluated with ten-fold CV, but its relationship to a separate pilot cohort is not a clinical external validation.
ai_technology: SVM (polynomial/radial kernels), XGBoost and MLP classified first-trimester LC-MRM-MS protein profiles; the SVM result was compared with FMF screening.
